item.title: Man shot by ICE agent isn't getting proper medical care in detention, lawyer says
item.description: Three days after ICE agents shot and injured Wilber Rafael Garces Perez in Austin, Texas, questions linger about the details around this enforcement operation.

item.title: How abuse in some of Tennessee's juvenile prisons remained under wraps
item.description: Employees at a group of privately-run juvenile detention facilities across Tennessee failed to report suspected physical and sexual abuse to the state, and were allegedly discouraged from calling 911.

item.title: HHS cancels health insurance of 760,000 individuals enrolled in healthcare.gov plans
